none: PAS LIN-82C4A1: Roman copper alloy finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of a Roman finger ring, probably Henig Type XI. Only half of the bezel and part of one shoulder remains. The bezel would have been a large flat oval. The shoulder is D-shaped in cross-section and tapers from the bezel. There is a slight linear scratch on the bezel which may be accidental but also may be the start of a letter, for example the letter 'T' in the inscription TOT which is…
